text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This research paper presents a spatially explicit, national-scale (Brazil) modeling framework for land-use and land-cover (LULC) change prediction through 2050. It uses a partial equilibrium economic model (GLOBIOM-Brazil) with detailed representation of agriculture and spatially explicit land-use change at approximately 50 km resolution. The study explicitly implements multiple future scenarios (including full enforcement and imperfect enforcement of Brazil’s Forest Code) with quantitative comparisons of deforestation, agricultural expansion, restoration, and emissions outcomes. It reports spatially explicit LULC projections (maps of deforestation, cropland, pasture, and native vegetation changes) and validates model results against observed data. The primary focus is on LULC prediction/simulation related to environmental legislation impacts. Thus, it meets all core inclusion criteria and none of the exclusion criteria. It is not a review article.)
